tools.name: search_robots
tools.description: Find open-source robot kits by words, type or budget. Returns up to 10 robots with the lowest in-stock USD price, stock state, license and page link. Call with no arguments to list everything.

tools.name: get_robot
tools.description: Full facts for one robot: what it is, license, difficulty, build time, cost lines, every seller offer, and sourced facts with links and checked dates.

tools.name: where_to_buy
tools.description: Every seller listing for one robot, in-stock whole kits first, with price, currency, stock, checked date, a buy link and the seller page.
